title: Coconut Stracciatella Gelato
steps: Combine shredded coconut and coconut milk. Warm gently to 120–140°F for 5–10 minutes to soften.
Whisk the sugar, locust bean gum, and xanthan gum together. Whisk the egg yolks in a large bowl.
Heat cream, milk, and salt over medium heat, whisking periodically, to 150°F. Remove from the heat.
Slowly drizzle the hot dairy into the yolks while whisking. Return to the pot with the sugar mixture and agave, whisking to combine.
Heat over medium, stirring continuously, to 175°F. Remove from heat immediately.
Add vanilla and emulsify with an immersion blender for 15–20 seconds. Add the coconut mixture and blend briefly, no more than 15 seconds, without puréeing.
Chill in an ice bath, whisking to cool. Press plastic wrap onto the surface and refrigerate overnight.
Pre-chill the Musso 5030 for 13 minutes with the lid closed. Stir the base briefly, then churn for 6 minutes.
Melt the chocolate and oil and hold at 104–113°F. Between minutes 6 and 7, drizzle into the gelato to form thin shards.
Transfer immediately to a pre-chilled container and freeze at least 3 hours before serving.
reviewFlags: The source describes this recipe as a pre-draft.
sourceNote: Inspired by Claire Saffitz’s Coffee Oreo ice cream.
